remarks: SELLERS WILL BE REVIEWING OFFERS ON MONDAY 11/10 AT 12:00 This gracious Colonial in the heart of coveted Old Hill has been home to one family for 47 years. The welcoming foyer with its sweeping staircase is flanked by a generously sized dining room with fireplace and living room with fireplace and custom built-ins. A paneled study and a sun room provide versatile spaces for work or relaxing.A thoughtfully designed recent addition enhances the home's functionality with a spacious mudroom entry, butler's pantry with sink and dishwasher, a large laundry room with sink, and a walk-in pantry. The chef's kitchen features a huge granite island, high end appliances, vaulted ceiling and custom windows that bring in natural light and opens to the family room, creating a warm central gathering space.The property offers mature plantings, a charming brook, and an expansive lawn bordered by established trees. A generous deck overlooks the landscape and provides an ideal setting for outdoor dining and entertaining.The second floor includes a primary bedroom with built-ins and full bath, along with three additional bedrooms and a hall bath. A finished third floor offers a playroom and office. A classic Old Hill residence with character, light, and room to live comfortably both indoors and out.
